metadata.title: Nvidia jumped 31% on Jensen Huang's return. A day later, the AI trade sold off: AlphaCheck

content.text:
Good morning. Stocks fell on Tuesday as the chip sector sold off and shares of Anthropic (ANT) declined below their IPO price of $83.
Nearly every corner of the AI trade fell, with semiconductor stocks leading the Tech (XLK) sector lower. AI chip giant Nvidia stock retreated following a 31% jump in the prior session on the heels of Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO.
Here's a check of the markets this morning, based on a heat map powered by Yahoo Finance's AlphaSpace.
Here are some other notable stocks that Yahoo Finance readers are viewing this morning: Dick's Sporting (DKS), Best Buy (BBS), HPE (HPE), and Dell (DELL).
